The graph is connected 4Q4 and has first Betti number 113, independently consistent with arithmetic genus 129 by adjunction. For the sign action, four node orbits per coordinate direction have stabilizer of order two reversing oriented edges; character induction gives multiplicities 4|S|-1. An extracted standalone checker verifies exact graph/Fourier arithmetic and finite-field base geometry, not the infinite proof.
